columns.name: ID
columns.description: Number to uniquely identify each location

columns.name: URL
columns.description: Detail page on the Connect Chicago website

columns.name: ORGANIZATION NAME
columns.description: Name of the location

columns.name: ORGANIZATION TYPE
columns.description: Type of organization, which may be the following: Chicago Housing Authority; Chicago Public Library; Chicago Public School; City Colleges of Chicago; Community Service Center; Community Technology Center; Senior Center; WorkForce Center; WorkNet Chicago;

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: Combination of all address fields

columns.name: PHONE NUMBER
columns.description: Location phone number, including area code.

columns.name: HOURS
columns.description: Location hours of operation.

columns.name: WEBSITE
columns.description: If the location has a website or webpage, the URL for it.

columns.name: APPOINTMENT
columns.description: Does this location take appointments? (1=yes, 0=no, 2=unknown)

columns.name: INTERNET
columns.description: Does this location have internet access? (1=yes, 0=no, 2=unknown)

columns.name: WIFI
columns.description: Does this location have wireless internet? (1=yes, 0=no, 2=unknown)

columns.name: TRAINING
columns.description: Does this location offer training? (1=yes, 0=no, 2=unknown)

columns.name: PC USE RESTRICTIONS
columns.description: Restrictions on the use of computers at this location.

columns.name: HARDWARE PUBLIC
columns.description: Number of public computers available.

columns.name: ASSISTIVE TECHNOLOGY
columns.description: Software for aiding the blind or disabled.

columns.name: INTERNET UPLOAD
columns.description: Upload speed in Mbps

columns.name: INTERNET DOWNLOAD
columns.description: Download speed in Mbps.

columns.name: VOLUNTEERS USED
columns.description: Are volunteers used at this location?

columns.name: VOLUNTEERS USED HOW
columns.description: If volunteers are used, for what purpose?

columns.name: VOLUNTEERS WANTED HOW
columns.description: If volunteers are needed, for what purpose?

columns.name: PUBLIC WIFI DETAIL
columns.description: Wifi encryption (if any), other notes about WiFi.

columns.name: NEAREST PARKING
columns.description: Either free or paid.

columns.name: NEAREST PARKING DETAIL
columns.description: Details and directions for nearest parking lot.

columns.name: PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION DETAIL
columns.description: Details and directions for nearest CTA or Metra stations or bus stops.

columns.name: TIME ALLOWED PER USER
columns.description: Either timed, unlimited or empty.

columns.name: TIME ALLOWED PER USER DETAIL
columns.description: Time in minutes if there is a limit.

columns.name: ROOM LIST
columns.description: Location of computer labs within the address.

columns.name: HANDICAP ACCESS DETAIL
columns.description: Details for handicap accessibility

columns.name: AGENCY LEADERSHIP CONTACT
columns.description: Contact person for the parent organization or department.

columns.name: AGENCY STAFF PERSON CONTACT EMAIL
columns.description: Email address for AGENCY LEADERSHIP CONTACT.

columns.name: TWITTER HANDLE
columns.description: Twitter account for the location

columns.name: TRAINING TYPES
columns.description: Types of technology training provided at the location. For more information, see: http://weconnectchicago.org/learn/

columns.name: FLICKR TAG
columns.description: Used for tagging photos in Flickr. Generated based Id and location name

columns.name: TRAINING HEADLINE
columns.description: If training is offered, the name of the training program.

columns.name: TRAINING DESCRIPTION
columns.description: If training is offered, a description of the training program.

columns.name: TRAINING URL
columns.description: If training is offered, website for more information.

columns.name: LOCATION LEADERSHIP
columns.description: Contact person who is responsible for running the location.

columns.name: LOCATION LEADERSHIP EMAIL
columns.description: Email address for LOCATION LEADERSHIP.

columns.name: PCC STAFF PERSON
columns.description: Contact person for the computer lab.

columns.name: PCC STAFF PERSON EMAIL
columns.description: Email address for PCC STAFF PERSON.
